races.title: Racing Again November 19th Beginners Chase
races.verdict: WHISPERING WILLOW underperformed over hurdles last time but had previously shaped well over fences and is worth chancing back in this sphere with first-time cheekpieces applied. In-form hurdler Might Be The One is feared most if transferring that ability to fences with Kimy also respected after a promising chase debut at Tramore. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE) MIGHT BE THE ONE (IRE) KIMY (FR)

races.title: Horse & Jockey Handicap Chase
races.verdict: STONEYFORD LADY scored over C&D last year and bounced back from a Ballinrobe fall with a good second at Killarney last month. She looks sure to make a bold bid now returned to this venue. Listowel chase winner Potters Pal is open to further improvement on debut for a new yard with Aurea Fortuna also respected after bouncing back to form last time.
